correctness.rationale: The impact points are the two nearest points and the inward radial three-cycle at the centroid; flight lengths are 1-2r and 1-sqrt(3)r, incidence cosines 1 and sqrt(3)/2. Exact equatorial ellipsoid curvature is 1/r in plane and beta²/r vertically. Scalar symplectic kicks 2/(rc) and 2 beta² c/r give arcosh trace expressions; monotonicity gives opposite strict signs exactly when 1<beta²<4/3. The periodic-to-Gibbs passage uses standard Hölder equilibrium measures concentrating at periodic support and continuity of line-bundle expansions. All quantifiers concern fixed r=1/10 and collision-normalized exponents, not time-normalized or every Gibbs law. Checker logs are corroboration, not proof.
